_about: Single source of truth for the toolkit's units. Everything else - status
tables, the component index, the copy-tier claims in each README - should be
checked against this rather than maintained in parallel, because duplicated
JSON rather than YAML on purpose: the packaging tests parse it, and they run
in the stdlib-only CI job where no YAML parser is installed. A registry that
needs a dependency to read is a registry the bare job cannot verify.
- toolkit_deps matches the actual relative imports (no drift, no over-claim)
- the dependency graph is acyclic and respects layer ordering
- every unit imports cleanly when copied out with its declared deps
- copy_tier matches what the unit's README tells the reader to copy

Each unit records `example` (a runnable snippet in examples/cookbook.py) and `recipes` (the named compositions it appears in). Both are Definition-of-Done items from docs/PLAYBOOK.md, and test_packaging.py asserts the referenced functions actually exist, so neither can be claimed without being true.

layers.0: contracts - types and protocols, imports nothing

policy.layer_rule: a unit may depend only on its own layer or lower
policy.production_ready_gate: used in at least one real project; tests alone never suffice

units.capability: the only place a vendor SDK may be imported; at least two implementations per port
limitations: every vendor import is lazy, so failures surface at call time not construction
TesseractSource needs the tesseract binary on PATH, which no extra can install

units.capability: content-addressed caching of model calls, keyed per text
limitations: no expiry or eviction
identity falls back to the class name for a wrapped model with no model_version

units.capability: structure-aware chunking that carries page and bbox provenance into every chunk
limitations: tables chunked as text
sentence splitting is regex plus an abbreviation list
default token counter is a heuristic: measured against cl100k_base on 2780 real chunks it leaves 10% of chunks over a 512-token budget, worst 1.59x; pass ChunkConfig.token_counter for an exact count

units.capability: command line interface: ingest a corpus once to a saved index, then ask, evaluate and inspect it
limitations: no server or daemon: one command, one process
every vendor import is lazy and inside a function, so a missing backend surfaces at call time
ask and eval rebuild the embedder from the index manifest; a mismatch re-embeds rather than failing
no shell completion, no config file; flags only

units.capability: order-preserving bounded parallel map with selective retry
limitations: threads only, no asyncio
no cross-process coordination

units.capability: shared document, chunk, provenance and usage contracts plus the error taxonomy
limitations: no tenant or lineage fields yet; see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 6

units.capability: DAG execution with a ready queue, honest failure propagation, conditional nodes, per-node retry and optional checkpointed resume
limitations: threads, not processes: CPU-bound nodes contend on the GIL
node_timeout bounds how long the scheduler waits, not how long a node runs
single machine; no distributed coordination
checkpointed nodes must return JSON-serialisable values
no dynamic fan-out: the graph is fixed before execution starts

units.capability: reading order, heading hierarchy, page furniture and overlap resolution over positioned text spans
limitations: table structure not reconstructed
no OCR or layout model
reading order is page-number order across pages
no text orientation: rotated text is a separate reading flow and is excluded by `PdfPlumberSource`, which reports the count as `rotated_glyphs_excluded`; a landscape page loses its body

units.capability: crash-resumable multi-step execution on a SQL checkpoint table, with leasing
limitations: linear only, no DAG or fan-out - compose with `dag` for graphs
single machine
step results must be JSON-serialisable

units.capability: unsupervised record matching: learned blocking, Fellegi-Sunter with EM, clustering, and single-record scoring against a kept model
limitations: assumes conditional independence between fields
blocking is in-memory
average linkage is cubic in a region
score_record does no blocking: the caller chooses the candidates, and a model kept across data drift goes stale with nothing to say so
the date comparator refuses an ambiguous numeric date rather than guessing the day/month order, because a record carries no document-level hint

units.capability: golden sets keyed on snippets, IR metrics, regression diff naming broken cases
limitations: answer scoring is substring matching
binary relevance only
no significance testing
relevance is judged by verbatim snippet containment, which favours lexical retrieval; unresolvable cases are reported as dataset_errors rather than scored as misses

units.capability: golden sets keyed on field paths, extraction metrics including the silent error rate, regression diff naming broken documents
limitations: the golden set is the measurement; a mis-transcribed expectation reads as a model error forever
no statistical significance testing
field accuracy weights every path equally; required_paths and the silent error rate carry the distinction instead
rows are matched on description and amount only, so a table identified by three columns under-counts matches
cost is only meaningful behind an adapter that populates Usage.cost_usd

units.capability: schema-driven extraction with a targeted repair loop, exact-decimal values and word-level grounded evidence per field, plus multi-document splitting
limitations: one model call per attempt over the whole document; truncation is reported, not repaired
grounding needs word-level geometry for cell-precise evidence; without words it falls back to block boxes
row locality anchors on the most distinctive string cell, so a row with no distinctive string grounds without it
splitter is heuristic and needs furniture classification

units.capability: pre-flight token and cost budget, sliding-window rate limit, selective retry
limitations: state is per-process, so N workers each get the full budget

units.capability: deterministic graph algorithms: topological order and layers, cycle reporting, SCC, reachability, shortest and critical path, transitive reduction
limitations: unweighted graphs only except in shortest_path
no graph mutation; build a new Graph instead
transitive_reduction is O(V*E) via full reachability, fine to thousands of nodes
no serialisation format

units.capability: indirect prompt-injection defense: source delimiting, pattern neutralisation, output policy
limitations: patterns are English and literal, evaded by obfuscation
cannot detect a false claim with no imperative
no claim entailment checking

units.capability: rank fusion across incomparable retrievers, budgeted rerank cascade, MMR
limitations: cannot improve recall
MMR is quadratic in the candidate pool
no learning to rank

units.capability: the LLM port over plain HTTP for OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-style APIs, with no vendor SDK
limitations: no streaming, tool calling or structured output; ports.LLM leaves them out deliberately
classifies failures but never retries: wrap in GovernedLLM
no retry_after, because the transport returns a status and a body but not headers
Usage.cost_usd stays 0.0; there is no per-model price table
synchronous: one call, one thread. Use concurrency.bounded_map to fan out
a provider that is only nearly OpenAI-compatible may still need its own branch
images are sent as base64 in the request body, unresized and unchecked against the provider's own size caps

units.capability: KnowledgeBase: ingest a folder, ask with verified citations, save and reload the index without re-parsing
limitations: chunks and their vectors are mirrored in memory; `save`/`load` persist them to disk
sequential across documents; use `dag` to fan out, and `IngestConfig.on_document` to watch progress
cross-process resume re-ingests rather than replays, because chunks are process-local; `save`/`load` is the cheap path - 38 minutes of parsing reloads in under a second

units.capability: protocols the toolkit needs from the outside world
limitations: no async variants
no streaming or tool-calling surface on LLM

units.capability: resolve an AI provider from the environment: key, endpoint, model and API style, or an error naming what to set
limitations: two API styles only: openai and anthropic
shortcut default models go stale as vendors rename them; override with TOOLKIT_MODEL
environment variables and a .toolkit.env file only; no Vault, Secrets Manager or keychain
checks that settings are present and coherent, never that the key works - that needs a network call
no per-model cost table, so Usage.cost_usd is not populated from here
